features.name: Amazon EFS Elastic throughput mode
features.quote: Elastic Throughput is ideal for spiky and unpredictable workloads with performance requirements that are difficult to forecast.
features.predecessor: EFS Provisioned or Bursting throughput mode

features.name: Amazon EFS Archive storage class
features.quote: With EFS Archive, you now have a cost-effective way to retain even your coldest data so that it’s always available to power new business insights.
features.predecessor: EFS Standard with lifecycle management to EFS Infrequent Access (IA) as the coldest tier

features.name: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS Intelligent-Tiering storage class
features.quote: With FSx Intelligent-Tiering, customers no longer need to provision or manage storage and get automatic storage cost optimization as data access patterns change.
features.predecessor: FSx for OpenZFS SSD storage class with provisioned SSD capacity

features.name: AWS DataSync Enhanced mode
features.quote: With Enhanced mode, you can transfer datasets with virtually unlimited numbers of objects at higher levels of performance than Basic mode.
features.predecessor: A DataSync task in Basic mode, for example with an on-premises agent

features.name: AWS Transfer Family web apps
features.quote: With Transfer Family web apps, you can provide your workforce with a fully managed, branded, and secure portal for your end users to browse, upload, and download data in S3.
features.predecessor: A Transfer Family SFTP server or a custom-built web portal for browser access to S3

features.name: AWS DataSync Azure Blob Storage location
features.quote: Using DataSync, you can move your object data at scale from Azure Blob Storage to AWS Storage services such as Amazon S3.
features.predecessor: Copying Azure Blob Storage data with AzCopy or custom scripts, or a device-based transfer

features.name: S3 applies SSE-S3 by default to all new objects
features.quote: With this update, Amazon S3 will automatically apply SSE-S3 as the base level of Default Encryption setting for all new buckets and for existing buckets without any customer configured encryption setting.
patterns: \bSSE-S3\b[^\n]{0,100}\b(by default|automatically|base level|all new objects|every new object|already (encrypts?|applied))
features.predecessor: Turning on default bucket encryption or a bucket policy that denies unencrypted PutObject requests

features.name: AWS KMS external key store (XKS)
features.quote: XKS may help you address your compliance needs where encryption keys for regulated workloads must be outside AWS and solely under your control.
features.predecessor: A KMS custom key store backed by AWS CloudHSM, or importing key material into KMS

features.name: S3 blocks SSE-C by default on new buckets
features.quote: In April 2026, Amazon S3 deployed an update so all new general purpose buckets have SSE-C encryption disabled for all new write requests.
features.predecessor: SSE-C usable on any new bucket without an opt-in

features.name: Dual-layer server-side encryption with KMS keys (DSSE-KMS)
features.quote: Dual-layer server-side encryption with keys stored in AWS Key Management Service (DSSE-KMS) is designed to meet National Security Agency CNSSP 15 for FIPS compliance and Data-at-Rest Capability Package (DAR CP) Version 5.0 guidance for two layers of CNSA encryption.
features.predecessor: SSE-KMS (one layer) combined with client-side encryption before upload to get two layers

features.name: Multiple MFA devices per IAM user and root user
features.quote: Now it is possible to add up to eight MFA devices per user, including FIDO security keys, software time-based one-time password (TOTP) with virtual authenticator applications, or hardware TOTP tokens.
features.predecessor: A single MFA device per IAM user, with account recovery if the device is lost

features.name: Passkeys as an MFA method for IAM and root users
features.quote: IAM now allows you to secure access to AWS accounts using passkeys for multi-factor authentication (MFA) with support for built-in authenticators, such as Touch ID on Apple MacBooks and Windows Hello facial recognition on PCs.
features.predecessor: FIDO U2F security keys, virtual (TOTP) or hardware TOTP MFA devices

features.name: Centralized root access management for member accounts
features.quote: Now, administrators can remove unnecessary root credentials for member accounts in AWS Organizations and then, if needed, perform tightly scoped privileged actions using temporary credentials.
features.predecessor: Securing the root user of each member account individually (password, MFA, access keys) and signing in as root for tasks

features.name: S3 Block Public Access organization-level policy in AWS Organizations
features.quote: S3 Block Public Access at the organization level uses a single configuration that controls all public access settings across accounts within your organization.
features.predecessor: Account-level S3 Block Public Access in each account, protected by an SCP

features.name: AWS Lake Formation hybrid access mode
features.quote: With the Hybrid Access Mode, you now have an incremental path wherein you can enable Lake Formation for a specific set of users without interrupting other existing users or workloads.
features.predecessor: Moving every principal to Lake Formation permissions at once, or keeping IAM and S3 bucket policies

features.name: AWS Lambda SnapStart
features.quote: Lambda SnapStart offers improved startup times by initializing the function’s code ahead of time, taking a snapshot of the initialized execution environment, and caching it.
features.predecessor: Lambda provisioned concurrency to keep execution environments initialized

features.name: Amazon EKS Auto Mode
features.quote: Amazon EKS Auto Mode simplifies running Kubernetes by offloading cluster operations to AWS, improves the performance and security of your applications, and helps optimize compute costs.
features.predecessor: EKS managed node groups or self-managed nodes with Cluster Autoscaler or Karpenter that you operate

features.name: Lambda maximum concurrency for an SQS event source mapping
features.quote: Maximum Concurrency for SQS as an event source allows customers to control the maximum concurrent invokes by the Amazon SQS event source.
features.predecessor: Function-level reserved concurrency to throttle SQS consumption

features.name: EC2 Auto Scaling instance refresh rollback (including automatic rollback on alarms)
features.quote: With today’s launch, you can use rollback to undo changes an instance refresh made when it fails.
features.predecessor: Instance refresh or a CloudFormation rolling update without rollback, so a failed rollout is reverted by hand

features.name: ALB target group health requirements (minimum healthy targets, DNS failover and routing failover)
features.quote: This release adds support to configure the minimum count or percentage of targets that must be healthy, and what actions the load balancer takes when the threshold is not met.
features.predecessor: Route 53 health checks and failover routing in front of the load balancer

features.name: Amazon S3 Express One Zone
features.quote: S3 Express One Zone can improve data access speeds by 10x and reduce request costs by 50% compared to S3 Standard.
features.predecessor: S3 Standard (or S3 One Zone-IA) general purpose buckets

features.name: AWS KMS on-demand key rotation and custom rotation periods
features.quote: You can now customize the frequency of rotation period between 90 days to 7 years (2560 days) as well as invoke key rotation on demand for customer managed KMS keys.
features.predecessor: Automatic annual KMS rotation, or creating a new key and repointing the alias to rotate immediately

features.name: AWS Secrets Manager managed external secrets
features.quote: At launch, managed external secrets feature is available for 3 listed partners — Salesforce, BigID and Snowflake.
features.predecessor: A custom rotation Lambda function that rotates the SaaS provider secret

features.name: S3 Lifecycle default minimum object size of 128 KB for transitions
features.quote: While the object size filter for your existing S3 Lifecycle rules will not automatically change, this new default behavior will be applied to any new or modified S3 Lifecycle configuration.
features.predecessor: Lifecycle transition rules applied to all objects, including very small ones, with no size default

features.name: AWS Direct Connect native 400 Gbps dedicated connections
features.quote: Native 400 Gbps connections provide higher bandwidth, without the operational overhead of managing multiple 100 Gbps connections in a link aggregation group.
features.predecessor: A LAG of several 100 Gbps (or smaller) dedicated connections

features.name: AWS Backup cold storage tier for Amazon EBS snapshots (EBS Snapshots Archive)
features.quote: You can now use AWS Backup to transition your EBS Snapshots to EBS Snapshots Archive and manage their lifecycle, alongside AWS Backup’s other supported resources.
features.predecessor: EBS backups kept in warm storage only (or EBS snapshots in the standard tier)

features.name: ElastiCache for Valkey
features.quote: ElastiCache for Valkey is now available in all AWS regions.
features.predecessor: ElastiCache for Redis OSS (node-based clusters or replication groups)

features.name: ElastiCache Serverless (including reads from replicas)
features.quote: With ElastiCache Serverless, you can create a highly available and scalable cache in less than a minute, eliminating the need to plan for, provision, and manage cache cluster capacity.
features.predecessor: Node-based ElastiCache cluster or replication group that the team sizes, scales and places in Availability Zones. Reading from replicas on a serverless cache (the cache-pavilion-007 claim) is not dated by this page: needs-verification

features.name: DMS Schema Conversion
features.quote: DMS Schema Conversion is a fully managed feature of AWS DMS that automatically assesses and converts the database schema to a format compatible with the target database service in AWS, enabling you to modernize your database and analytics workloads.
features.predecessor: AWS Schema Conversion Tool (SCT) run on a workstation

features.name: DynamoDB on-demand maximum throughput
features.quote: Starting today, you can optionally configure maximum read or write (or both) throughput for individual on-demand tables and associated secondary indexes, making it easy to balance costs and performance.
features.predecessor: On-demand mode with only account-level quotas, or provisioned capacity with auto scaling and a chosen maximum to bound spend

features.name: DynamoDB warm throughput
features.quote: You can now check your tables’ warm throughput value to assess if your table can handle large traffic spikes for peak events.
features.predecessor: Letting on-demand or auto scaling adapt to the spike (throttling risk), or raising provisioned capacity ahead of the event

features.name: DMS Serverless
features.quote: AWS DMS Serverless is now available in all AWS Regions, except China (Beijing, operated by Sinnet), China (Ningxia, operated by NWCD), AWS GovCloud (US-East), and AWS GovCloud (US-West).
features.predecessor: DMS replication instance that the team sizes, provisions and patches

features.name: Aurora I/O-Optimized
features.quote: With Aurora I/O-Optimized, there are zero charges for read and write I/O operations—you only pay for your database instances and storage usage, making it easy to predict your database spend up front.
features.predecessor: Aurora Standard configuration with per-request I/O charges

features.name: Aurora Serverless v2 scale to zero (auto-pause at 0 ACU)
features.quote: Instead of scaling down to 0.5 ACUs, the database can now scale down to 0 ACUs.
features.predecessor: Aurora Serverless v2 with a 0.5 ACU minimum, or stopping and starting the cluster on a schedule

features.name: RDS gp3 storage
features.quote: Amazon RDS gp3 volumes give you the flexibility to provision storage performance independently of storage capacity, paying only for the resources you need.
features.predecessor: RDS General Purpose (gp2) or Provisioned IOPS (io1) storage

features.name: EventBridge Pipes
features.quote: EventBridge Pipes makes it easy to connect your applications with data from sources including Amazon SQS, Amazon Kinesis, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon Managed Streaming Kafka, self-managed Kafka, and Amazon MQ.
features.predecessor: A Lambda function (or custom consumer code) that polls the source, filters, enriches and calls the target

features.name: EventBridge Scheduler
features.quote: EventBridge Scheduler enables customers to schedule millions of events and tasks across 200+ AWS services without provisioning or managing the underlying infrastructure.
features.predecessor: EventBridge scheduled rule (cron or rate expression) on the default event bus

features.name: Regional NAT gateway (regional availability mode)
features.quote: With this launch, you can create a NAT Gateway and set its availability to regional.
features.predecessor: One zonal NAT gateway in each Availability Zone with a route table per zone

features.name: Site-to-Site VPN Large Bandwidth Tunnel (5 Gbps)
features.quote: With this launch, customers can now configure their tunnel bandwidth to 5 Gbps, reducing the need to deploy complex protocols such as ECMP while ensuring consistent bandwidth performance.
features.predecessor: Standard 1.25 Gbps tunnels spread with ECMP across several tunnels or connections on a transit gateway, or Direct Connect

features.name: Database Savings Plans
features.quote: Database Savings Plans automatically apply to eligible serverless and provisioned instance usage regardless of supported engine, instance family, size, deployment option, or AWS Region.
features.predecessor: Reserved DB instances, reserved cache nodes and DynamoDB reserved capacity

features.name: Cost allocation tag backfill
features.quote: This retroactive application feature is available in all Commercial AWS Regions.
features.predecessor: Tags apply to cost data only from the activation date forward

features.name: Athena query result reuse
features.quote: Query Result Reuse works by returning a previously stored query result when a repeat query is submitted.
features.predecessor: Re-running the query, or caching or materializing results outside Athena (for example CTAS or an application cache)

features.name: CloudFront origin access control (OAC)
features.quote: Origin Access Control improves upon Origin Access Identity by strengthening security and deepening feature integrations.
features.predecessor: CloudFront origin access identity (OAI)

features.name: Target tracking with metric math (SQS backlog per instance or task)
features.quote: Now, if the custom metric is a simple function of other existing metrics, you can use CloudWatch Metric Math in the Target Tracking policy, instead of publishing (and paying for) a new custom CloudWatch metric.
features.predecessor: Publishing a custom CloudWatch backlog-per-instance metric yourself and tracking it. EC2 Auto Scaling 2022-12; Application Auto Scaling (ECS and others) followed in 2023-03

features.name: Predictive scaling for Amazon ECS services
features.quote: Predictive scaling is a new capability that harnesses advanced machine learning algorithms, pre-trained on millions of data points, to proactively scale out ECS services ahead of anticipated demand surges.
features.predecessor: Scheduled scaling, target tracking or step scaling only

features.name: Aurora Global Database switchover (renamed from managed planned failover)
features.quote: Starting today, we are also renaming “Managed Planned Failover” to “Global Database Switchover”, which is a fully managed cross-region database failover experience meant for planned events such as regional rotations.
features.predecessor: Managed planned failover (same capability under its older name, before 2023-08); or detaching and promoting a secondary cluster

features.name: NAT gateway multiple secondary IPv4 addresses (up to 8)
features.quote: Feb 1, 2023 Starting today, you can configure your NAT Gateway to support up to 440,000 concurrent connections to a unique destination by adding multiple IP addresses to same NAT Gateway.
features.predecessor: One IP address per NAT gateway (55,000 concurrent connections to one destination) and extra NAT gateways to scale

features.name: Firehose zero buffering
features.quote: With zero buffering, customers can setup a Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose stream to not buffer data before delivery, and most streams with no additional processing are delivered within five seconds.
features.predecessor: Buffer interval of at least 60 seconds

features.name: Security Hub (unified, 2025) versus Security Hub CSPM
features.quote: With general availability, Security Hub now includes near real-time risk analytics, advanced trends, unified enablement and management, and streamlined pricing across multiple AWS security services.
features.predecessor: AWS Security Hub as a findings aggregator with standards checks (now documented as AWS Security Hub CSPM)

features.name: Amazon Aurora DSQL
features.quote: Aurora DSQL enables you to build always available applications with virtually unlimited scalability, the highest availability, and zero infrastructure management.
features.predecessor: Aurora Global Database (single writer Region) or DynamoDB global tables for multi-Region writes

features.name: DynamoDB on-demand price cut (50%) and lower global tables prices
features.quote: Starting today, we have made Amazon DynamoDB even more cost-effective by reducing prices for on-demand throughput by 50% and global tables by up to 67%.
features.predecessor: Provisioned capacity (with reserved capacity) as the lowest-cost mode for steady, forecastable traffic

features.name: AWS Backup hourly backup frequency
features.predecessor: Daily or 12-hour backup schedules
features.note: Undated: no AWS page found dates hourly frequency. The backup plan options page states it without a date ("Using the console, you can choose a frequency of every hour, 12 hours, daily, weekly, or monthly."), and the AWS Backup document history has no hourly entry. Undatable, so treated as post-guide.

features.name: ECS service auto scaling minimum capacity 0
features.note: Undated: the ECS service auto scaling guide says 'If you want your task count to scale to zero when there's no work to be done, set a minimum capacity of 0.' with no date, and no dated AWS announcement was found. Undatable, so treated as post-guide. Predictive scaling for ECS is registered separately as ecs-predictive-scaling.
features.predecessor: ECS service auto scaling with a minimum of at least one task

features.name: AWS Lambda Managed Instances
features.quote: Nov 30, 2025 AWS Lambda Managed Instances lets you run Lambda functions on your Amazon EC2 instances
features.predecessor: Standard Lambda functions on Lambda-managed infrastructure (15-minute maximum timeout), or containers/EC2 for longer work

features.name: Lambda Managed Instances 90-minute timeout for asynchronous and event source mapping invocations
features.quote: 09 SEP 2026 in Announcements, AWS Lambda, Foundational (100) Permalink Share AWS Lambda now supports a 90-minute function timeout
features.predecessor: Lambda 15-minute maximum function timeout

preGuide.name: S3 Batch Replication for existing objects
preGuide.quote: Now, with S3 Batch Replication, you can synchronize existing objects between buckets.
preGuide.predecessor: Live replication (SRR or CRR) for new objects only, plus S3 Batch Operations copy or sync

preGuide.name: AWS Organizations backup policies applied to resources by tag
preGuide.quote: You can use backup policies to create and enforce backup policies across all of the accounts in your organization.
preGuide.predecessor: Backup plans configured account by account

preGuide.name: AWS Glue sensitive data detection
preGuide.quote: Sensitive data detection in AWS Glue identifies a variety of PII and other sensitive data like credit card numbers.
preGuide.note: GA before the cutoff. Later additions (250 entity types 2023-06; entity-level actions 2023-11) are post-guide, but refinery-004 would only depend on them if it names entity-level actions or the 250 types.

preGuide.name: RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster (two readable standbys)
preGuide.quote: This configuration supports up to 2x faster transaction commits than a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment with one standby, without compromising data durability.
preGuide.note: Pre-guide. Only later add-ons are post-guide: up to 15 read replicas (2023-04 MySQL, 2023-05 PostgreSQL), gp3 support (2024-02), IAM database authentication (2024-10).

preGuide.name: AWS Cloud WAN
preGuide.quote: Cloud WAN automatically creates a global network across AWS Regions by using Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) so that you can easily exchange routes around the world.
preGuide.note: GA 2022-07 (day from search summary of the preview blog update), before the cutoff. Post-guide additions: Service Insertion 2024-06, Direct Connect attachment 2024-11, Routing Policy 2025-11.
